title: Introducing LangSmith Sandboxes: Secure Code Execution for Agents
author: LangChain Accounts

discoveries.name: Auth Proxy for sandbox credential isolation
discoveries.description: Sandboxes access external services through an Authentication Proxy so secrets never touch the runtime. Same host-boundary injection pattern as Ironclaw WASM sandboxes.

discoveries.name: MicroVM isolation for agent code execution
discoveries.description: Hardware-virtualized microVMs (not containers/namespaces) provide kernel-level isolation between agent sandboxes. Converging with NVIDIA OpenShell approach.

discoveries.name: Warm sandbox pooling with autoscaling
discoveries.description: Pre-provisioned warm sandbox pools eliminate cold starts for agents. Automatic scaling as demand increases. WebSocket-based long-running sessions.

discoveries.name: Open SWE
discoveries.description: LangChain's open-source SWE agent built on LangSmith Sandboxes. CI-style agent that clones repos, installs deps, runs tests before opening PRs.

discoveries.name: 41% OpenClaw Skills Vulnerabilities
discoveries.description: ClawSecure research showing 41% of OpenClaw skills have security vulnerabilities -- motivating the need for sandbox isolation.
